description: Copy a shot (shot_id, or scene + shot; the copy goes right after it) or a whole scene (scene alone, or its id; the copy goes after it). Copies are separate: changing one never changes the other. Returns the new ids. One undo step for the person. For a new empty shot use add_shot.

id.description: Or: a shot id or a scene id from get_project.

scene.description: Scene index from 0. Alone: the whole scene; with shot: that shot.

shot.description: Shot index from 0 inside that scene (with scene; alone: in the scene on screen). A shot id works here too.

name: duplicate
